description: CR 603.2 Teysa, Envoy of Ghosts ignores combat damage dealt to another player
note: Three seats, so the damaged player and Teysa's controller differ: alice's Llanowar Elves hit carol while bob controls Teysa. "To you" is bob, so nothing triggers; a Teysa that admitted any damaged player would destroy the Elves. Teysa destroys the creature that hit bob is the same board with the attack aimed at bob.
